# Pairwise protein alignment of MMF1 and RPP1

Reads MMF1 and RPP1 from FASTA

Cleans sequences using Biostrings-native chartr()

Uses Needleman-Wunsch global pairwise alignment via pwalign::pairwiseAlignment

Produces wrapped alignment plot with domain annotations

```{r}

#| label: Import

fasta_path <- "Input/Dataset7.fa"

raw <- readAAStringSet(fasta_path)

ids <- c(
  MMF1 = "Col-0_AT3G44630",
  RPP1 = "Col-0_AT3G44480"
)

missing_ids <- ids[!ids %in% names(raw)]

if (length(missing_ids) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Sequence(s) not found in FASTA: ",
    paste(missing_ids, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

seqs <- raw[ids]
names(seqs) <- names(ids)
```

```{r}
#| label: Clean sequence
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| paged-print: false
clean_AAStringSet <- function(x, trim_terminal_X = TRUE) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  # Remove CLC alignment gaps and stop codons
  x <- gsub("[-*]", "", x)
  
  # Remove all whitespace, just in case
  x <- gsub("[[:space:]]+", "", x)
  
  # Uppercase
  x <- toupper(x)
  
  # Optional: remove only terminal X characters
  # Avoid removing internal X, because that shifts residue/domain coordinates.
  if (trim_terminal_X) {
    x <- gsub("^X+|X+$", "", x)
  }
  
  # Return to Biostrings object
  AAStringSet(x)
}

seqs_clean <- clean_AAStringSet(seqs, trim_terminal_X = TRUE)
names(seqs_clean) <- names(ids)

# Validate amino-acid alphabet
allowed <- strsplit("ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWYBXZJUO", "")[[1]]

bad_letters <- lapply(as.character(seqs_clean), function(s) {
  chars <- unique(strsplit(s, "")[[1]])
  setdiff(chars, allowed)
})

bad_letters <- bad_letters[lengths(bad_letters) > 0]

if (length(bad_letters) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Invalid amino-acid character(s) detected: ",
    paste(
      sprintf(
        "%s: %s",
        names(bad_letters),
        vapply(bad_letters, paste, collapse = ", ", FUN.VALUE = character(1))
      ),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

cat(sprintf("MMF1 length: %d aa\n", length(seqs_clean[["MMF1"]])))
cat(sprintf("RPP1 length: %d aa\n", length(seqs_clean[["RPP1"]])))
```

```{r}
  domain     = c("TIR",     "NBS",     "LRR"),
  start      = c(87,        288,       666),
```

```{r}
#| label: Functions
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| paged-print: false
build_position_map <- function(aln_seq) {
  chars <- strsplit(aln_seq, "")[[1]]
  
  ungap <- cumsum(chars != "-")
  ungap[chars == "-"] <- NA_integer_
  
  data.frame(
    alignment_pos = seq_along(chars),
    residue_pos   = ungap
  )
}

domain_to_alignment <- function(aln_seq, start, end) {
  pm <- build_position_map(aln_seq)
  
  aln_start <- min(
    pm$alignment_pos[!is.na(pm$residue_pos) & pm$residue_pos == start],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  aln_end <- max(
    pm$alignment_pos[!is.na(pm$residue_pos) & pm$residue_pos == end],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  if (!is.finite(aln_start) || !is.finite(aln_end)) {
    stop(
      "Domain coordinates could not be mapped to alignment. ",
      "Check whether the domain coordinates still match the cleaned MMF1 sequence.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  c(aln_start = aln_start, aln_end = aln_end)
}

map_domains_to_alignment <- function(domains, aln_seqs, names_vec, width = 100) {
  out <- vector("list", nrow(domains))
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(domains))) {
    idx <- match(domains$sequence[i], names_vec)
    
    if (is.na(idx)) {
      stop("Unknown sequence in domains: ", domains$sequence[i], call. = FALSE)
    }
    
    mapped <- domain_to_alignment(
      aln_seq = aln_seqs[[idx]],
      start   = domains$start[i],
      end     = domains$end[i]
    )
    
    as_start <- unname(mapped["aln_start"])
    as_end   <- unname(mapped["aln_end"])
    
    sb <- ((as_start - 1) %/% width) + 1
    eb <- ((as_end   - 1) %/% width) + 1
    
    rows <- vector("list", eb - sb + 1)
    
    for (b in sb:eb) {
      bk_start <- (b - 1) * width + 1
      
      rows[[b - sb + 1]] <- data.frame(
        sequence   = domains$sequence[i],
        domain     = domains$domain[i],
        fill_color = domains$fill_color[i],
        block      = b,
        x_min      = max(as_start, bk_start) - bk_start + 1,
        x_max      = min(as_end, bk_start + width - 1) - bk_start + 1,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    out[[i]] <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  }
  
  do.call(rbind, out)
}
```

```{r}
# Physicochemical classes for exact matches
aa_physico_class <- c(
  A = "hydrophobic", V = "hydrophobic", I = "hydrophobic", L = "hydrophobic",
  M = "hydrophobic", F = "hydrophobic", W = "hydrophobic", P = "hydrophobic",
  G = "hydrophobic",
  S = "polar",       T = "polar",       N = "polar",       Q = "polar",
  Y = "polar",       C = "polar",
  D = "charged_neg", E = "charged_neg",
  K = "charged_pos", R = "charged_pos", H = "charged_pos"

physico_colors <- c(
  hydrophobic = "#aec6e8",
  polar       = "#b2dfb0",
  charged_neg = "#c9b8d8",
  charged_pos = "#80cdc1"

# Grantham matrix for mismatch severity
grantham_score <- function(aa1, aa2) {
  aas <- c(
    "A","R","N","D","C","Q","E","G","H","I",
    "L","K","M","F","P","S","T","W","Y","V"
  )
  
  gmat <- matrix(c(
    0,112,111,126,195, 91,107, 60, 86, 94,102,106, 95,113, 27, 99, 58,148,112, 64,
    112,  0, 86, 96,180, 43, 54,125, 29, 97,102, 26, 91, 97,103,110, 71,101, 77, 96,
    111, 86,  0, 23,139, 46, 42, 80, 68,149,153, 94,142,158, 91, 46, 65,174,143,133,
    126, 96, 23,  0,154, 61, 45, 94, 81,168,172,101,160,177,108, 65, 85,181,160,152,
    195,180,139,154,  0,154,170,159,174,198,198,202,196,205,169,112,149,215,194,192,
    91, 43, 46, 61,154,  0, 29, 87, 24,109,113, 53,101,116, 76, 68, 42,130, 99, 96,
    107, 54, 42, 45,170, 29,  0, 98, 40,134,138, 56,126,140, 93, 80, 65,152,122,121,
    60,125, 80, 94,159, 87, 98,  0, 98,135,138,127,127,153, 42, 56, 59,184,147,109,
    86, 29, 68, 81,174, 24, 40, 98,  0, 94, 99, 32, 87,100, 77, 89, 47,115, 83, 84,
    94, 97,149,168,198,109,134,135, 94,  0,  5,102, 10, 21, 95,142, 89, 61, 33, 29,
    102,102,153,172,198,113,138,138, 99,  5,  0,107, 15, 22, 98,145, 92, 61, 36, 32,
    106, 26, 94,101,202, 53, 56,127, 32,102,107,  0, 95,102,103,121, 78,110, 85, 97,
    95, 91,142,160,196,101,126,127, 87, 10, 15, 95,  0, 28, 87,135, 81, 67, 36, 21,
    113, 97,158,177,205,116,140,153,100, 21, 22,102, 28,  0,114,155,103, 40, 22, 50,
    27,103, 91,108,169, 76, 93, 42, 77, 95, 98,103, 87,114,  0, 74, 38,147,114, 68,
    99,110, 46, 65,112, 68, 80, 56, 89,142,145,121,135,155, 74,  0, 58,177,144,124,
    58, 71, 65, 85,149, 42, 65, 59, 47, 89, 92, 78, 81,103, 38, 58,  0,128, 92, 69,
    148,101,174,181,215,130,152,184,115, 61, 61,110, 67, 40,147,177,128,  0, 37, 88,
    112, 77,143,160,194, 99,122,147, 83, 33, 36, 85, 36, 22,114,144, 92, 37,  0, 55,
    64, 96,133,152,192, 96,121,109, 84, 29, 32, 97, 21, 50, 68,124, 69, 88, 55,  0
  ), nrow = 20, byrow = TRUE, dimnames = list(aas, aas))
  
  if (!(aa1 %in% aas) || !(aa2 %in% aas)) return(NA_real_)
  
  gmat[aa1, aa2]
}

grantham_class <- function(score) {
  if (is.na(score)) return("mismatch_other")
  if (score <= 50)  return("mismatch_conservative")
  if (score <= 100) return("mismatch_moderate")
  "mismatch_radical"
}

mismatch_colors <- c(
  mismatch_conservative = "#ffd966",
  mismatch_moderate     = "#f4a030",
  mismatch_radical      = "#cc2b2b",
  mismatch_other        = "#999999"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: Convert alignment to data frame
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| paged-print: false
alignment_to_df <- function(aln_seqs, names_vec, width = 100, row_gap = 0.42) {
  seq_chars <- lapply(aln_seqs, function(x) strsplit(x, "")[[1]])
  
  aln_len <- length(seq_chars[[1]])
  n_seqs  <- length(seq_chars)
  
  if (n_seqs != 2) {
    stop("This plotting function expects exactly two aligned sequences.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  
  if (!all(vapply(seq_chars, length, integer(1)) == aln_len)) {
    stop("Aligned sequences are not the same length.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  
  r <- seq_chars[[1]]
  q <- seq_chars[[2]]
  
  fill_per_pos <- vapply(seq_len(aln_len), function(j) {
    aa1 <- r[j]
    aa2 <- q[j]
    
    if (aa1 == "-" || aa2 == "-") {
      return("#d6d6d6")
    }
    
    if (aa1 == aa2) {
      cls <- aa_physico_class[aa1]
      
      if (is.na(cls)) {
        return("#ffffff")
      }
      
      return(unname(physico_colors[cls]))
    }
    
    g <- grantham_score(aa1, aa2)
    cls <- grantham_class(g)
    
    unname(mismatch_colors[cls])
  }, character(1))
  
  status <- ifelse(
    r == q,
    "match",
    ifelse(r == "-" | q == "-", "gap", "mismatch")
  )
  
  df_list <- vector("list", n_seqs)
  
  for (i in seq_along(seq_chars)) {
    pos <- seq_len(aln_len)
    
    df_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
      sequence   = names_vec[i],
      y          = (n_seqs - i) * row_gap + 1,
      position   = pos,
      residue    = seq_chars[[i]],
      block      = ((pos - 1) %/% width) + 1,
      x          = ((pos - 1) %% width) + 1,
      status     = status,
      fill_color = fill_per_pos,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  do.call(rbind, df_list)
}

alignment_block_labels <- function(aln_seq, width = 100, by = 10) {
  chars <- strsplit(aln_seq, "")[[1]]
  
  res_pos <- cumsum(chars != "-")
  res_pos[chars == "-"] <- NA_integer_
  
  pos <- seq_along(chars)
  
  block      <- ((pos - 1) %/% width) + 1
  x_in_block <- ((pos - 1) %% width) + 1
  
  df <- data.frame(
    block   = block,
    x       = x_in_block,
    res_pos = res_pos
  )
  
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(df, df$block), function(d) {
    tick_x <- seq(1, width, by = by)
    
    out <- data.frame(
      block = unique(d$block),
      x     = tick_x,
      label = NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    for (j in seq_along(tick_x)) {
      hits <- d$res_pos[d$x == tick_x[j]]
      hits <- hits[!is.na(hits)]
      
      if (length(hits)) {
        out$label[j] <- as.character(hits[1])
      }
    }
    
    out[!is.na(out$label), , drop = FALSE]
  }))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: Main plotting function
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| paged-print: false
# --- PUBLICATION FIGURE REFERENCE ------------------------------------------
# Supports: Suppl. Fig. S1
#   Alignment plotting function
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_alignment_wrapped <- function(
    aln_seqs,
    names_vec,
    width             = 100,
    display_names     = names_vec,
    domain_df         = NULL,
    x_number_sequence = names_vec[2],
    x_break_by        = 10,
    filename          = NULL,
    row_gap           = 0.42
) {
  stopifnot(length(display_names) == length(names_vec))
  
  df <- alignment_to_df(
    aln_seqs  = aln_seqs,
    names_vec = names_vec,
    width     = width,
    row_gap   = row_gap
  )
  
  n_seqs   <- length(names_vec)
  n_blocks <- max(df$block)
  
  y_vals <- (n_seqs - seq_len(n_seqs)) * row_gap + 1
  y_top  <- max(y_vals)
  y_bot  <- min(y_vals)
  
  ref_idx <- match(x_number_sequence, names_vec)
  
  if (is.na(ref_idx)) {
    stop("`x_number_sequence` not found in names_vec.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  
  tick_df <- alignment_block_labels(
    aln_seq = aln_seqs[[ref_idx]],
    width   = width,
    by      = x_break_by
  )
  
  tile_h       <- 0.38
  domain_bar_h <- 0.22
  domain_gap   <- 0.12
  label_pad    <- 0.05
  
  y_lo     <- y_bot - tile_h / 2 - 0.45
  number_y <- y_bot - tile_h / 2 - 0.10
  
  domain_ymin   <- y_top + tile_h / 2 + domain_gap
  domain_ymax   <- domain_ymin + domain_bar_h
  domain_text_y <- domain_ymax + label_pad
  y_hi          <- domain_text_y + 0.22
  
  sub_df <- df[df$sequence == names_vec[1], ]
  
  n_match <- sum(sub_df$status == "match", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_gap   <- sum(sub_df$status == "gap", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_total <- nrow(sub_df)
  
  pct_id <- round(100 * n_match / (n_total - n_gap), 1)
  
  subtitle <- sprintf(
    "%s vs %s  |  Alignment length: %d  |  Identity: %.1f%%  |  Gaps: %d",
    display_names[1], display_names[2], n_total, pct_id, n_gap
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_tile(
      aes(fill = fill_color),
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.10,
      height = 0.38
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = residue),
      family = "mono",
      size = 1.5,
      color = "#1a1a1a"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = tick_df,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      aes(x = x, y = number_y, label = label),
      size = 3.0,
      vjust = 1,
      color = "#555555"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~block, ncol = 1, strip.position = "left") +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = y_vals,
      labels = display_names,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(1, width, by = x_break_by),
      labels = NULL,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_lo, y_hi), clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = "Pairwise protein sequence alignment",
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "Needleman-Wunsch global alignment + BLOSUM62  |  %s vs %s  |  Alignment length: %d  |  Identity: %.1f%%  |  Gaps: %d",
        display_names[1],
        display_names[2],
        n_total,
        pct_id,
        n_gap
      ),
      x = paste0("Residue position (", x_number_sequence, ")"),
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid       = element_blank(),
      strip.text       = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, color = "#222222"),
      axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 9, color = "#555555", margin = margin(t = 8)),
      axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x      = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "none",
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 9, color = "#555555"),
      plot.margin      = margin(6, 8, 4, 4),
      panel.spacing.y  = unit(-8, "pt")
    )
  
  if (!is.null(domain_df)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_rect(
        data = domain_df,
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        aes(
          xmin = x_min - 0.5,
          xmax = x_max + 0.5,
          ymin = domain_ymin,
          ymax = domain_ymax,
          fill = fill_color
        ),
        color = "#333333",
        linewidth = 0.3,
        alpha = 0.85
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = domain_df,
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        aes(
          x     = (x_min + x_max) / 2,
          y     = domain_text_y,
          label = domain
        ),
        size = 2.4,
        fontface = "bold",
        vjust = 0,
        color = "#333333"
      )
  }
  
  legend_data <- data.frame(
    x = c(1, 2.5, 4, 5.5, 1, 2.5, 4),
    label = c(
      "Hydrophobic", "Polar", "Charged\u2212", "Charged+",
      "Conservative", "Moderate", "Radical"
    ),
    col = c(
      unname(physico_colors["hydrophobic"]),
      unname(physico_colors["polar"]),
      unname(physico_colors["charged_neg"]),
      unname(physico_colors["charged_pos"]),
      unname(mismatch_colors["mismatch_conservative"]),
      unname(mismatch_colors["mismatch_moderate"]),
      unname(mismatch_colors["mismatch_radical"])
    ),
    group = factor(
      c(
        rep("Matches (physicochemical class)", 4),
        rep("Mismatches (Grantham severity)", 3)
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Mismatches (Grantham severity)",
        "Matches (physicochemical class)"
      )
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  p_legend <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = x, y = group)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = col),
      shape = 22,
      size = 6,
      color = "#444444",
      stroke = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      hjust = -0.25,
      size = 3.2,
      color = "#333333"
    ) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 12), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete() +
    labs(y = " ") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        face = "italic",
        size = 9,
        color = "#555555",
        hjust = 1,
        margin = margin(r = 8)
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "transparent"),
      plot.margin  = margin(4, 8, 4, 4)
    )
  
  combined <- p / p_legend +
    plot_layout(heights = c(n_blocks, 1), axes = "collect")
  
  print(combined)
  
  if (!is.null(filename)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = filename,
      plot     = combined,
      width    = 14,
      height   = max(4, n_blocks * 1.10) + 1.2,
      dpi      = 300
    )
    
    message("Saved to: ", filename)
  }
  
  invisible(combined)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: Needleman-Wunsch alignment
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| paged-print: false
#| fig.width: 14
#| fig.height: 22
#| fig-cap: |
#|   Supplementary Figure S1 | Pairwise sequence alignment of MMF1 and RPP1. Full-length protein
#|   sequences of Mediator of Microbiome Feedback 1 (MMF1) and Recognition of Peronospora parasitica
#|   1 (RPP1) were aligned using Needleman-Wunsch global pairwise alignment with the BLOSUM62
#|   substitution matrix (pwalign R package). Protein sequences were obtained from the assembled
#|   genomes (Fig. 7b). Residues are coloured according to biochemical properties at matched
#|   positions (hydrophobic, blue; polar, green; negatively charged, lavender; positively charged,
#|   teal) or by the degree of physicochemical divergence at mismatched positions based on Grantham
#|   scores (conservative ≤50, yellow; moderate 51--100, amber; radical >100, red). Gap positions are
#|   shown in grey. Annotated functional domains based on the sequence of RPP1 are indicated by
#|   coloured bars above the corresponding alignment blocks: the Toll/interleukin-1 receptor (TIR)
#|   domain, nucleotide-binding site (NBS) domain, and leucine-rich repeat (LRR) domain. Residue
#|   positions along the x-axis reflect that of RPP1. Overall sequence identity is 85.2% across an
#|   alignment length of 1,273 residues (66 gap positions).
# --- PUBLICATION FIGURE REFERENCE ------------------------------------------
# Produces: Suppl. Fig. S1
#   Pairwise protein alignment of MMF1 and RPP1 with domains
#   -> Output/Figures/pairwise_protein_alignment_with_domains.pdf
# ------------------------------------------------------------
message("Running Needleman-Wunsch global pairwise alignment with BLOSUM62 ...")

aln <- pwalign::pairwiseAlignment(
  pattern            = seqs_clean[["MMF1"]],
  subject            = seqs_clean[["RPP1"]],
  type               = "global",
  substitutionMatrix = "BLOSUM62",
  gapOpening         = 10,
  gapExtension       = 0.5
)

message(sprintf("Alignment score:   %.1f", score(aln)))
message(sprintf("Sequence identity: %.1f%%", 100 * pid(aln, type = "PID1")))

aln_seqs <- list(
  as.character(pattern(aln)),
  as.character(subject(aln))
)

names_vec <- c("MMF1", "RPP1")

domain_plot_df <- map_domains_to_alignment(
  domains   = domains,
  aln_seqs  = aln_seqs,
  names_vec = names_vec,
  width     = 100
)

plot_alignment_wrapped(
  aln_seqs          = aln_seqs,
  names_vec         = names_vec,
  width             = 100,
  display_names     = c("MMF1", "RPP1"),
  domain_df         = domain_plot_df,
  x_number_sequence = "RPP1",
  x_break_by        = 10,
  filename          = "pairwise_protein_alignment_with_domains.pdf"
)
```

```{r}
    95, 91,142,160,196,101,126,127, 87, 10, 15, 95,  0, 28, 87,135, 81, 67, 36, 21,
    113, 97,158,177,205,116,140,153,100, 21, 22,102, 28,  0,114,155,103, 40, 22, 50,
    27,103, 91,108,169, 76, 93, 42, 77, 95, 98,103, 87,114,  0, 74, 38,147,114, 68,
    99,110, 46, 65,112, 68, 80, 56, 89,142,145,121,135,155, 74,  0, 58,177,144,124,
    58, 71, 65, 85,149, 42, 65, 59, 47, 89, 92, 78, 81,103, 38, 58,  0,128, 92, 69,
    148,101,174,181,215,130,152,184,115, 61, 61,110, 67, 40,147,177,128,  0, 37, 88,
    112, 77,143,160,194, 99,122,147, 83, 33, 36, 85, 36, 22,114,144, 92, 37,  0, 55,

grantham_class <- function(score) {
  if (is.na(score)) return("mismatch_other")
  if (score <= 50)  return("mismatch_conservative")
  if (score <= 100) return("mismatch_moderate")
  "mismatch_radical"
}
```

```{r}
#| label: Build tidy data frame
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| paged-print: false

ref_name <- "Col-0_AT3G44630"

if (!ref_name %in% rownames(aln_mat)) {
  stop("Reference sequence '", ref_name, "' not found.", call. = FALSE)
}

ref_row <- aln_mat[ref_name, ]

cat("Building data frame ...\n")

rows <- vector("list", nrow(aln_mat))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(aln_mat))) {
  seq_aa  <- aln_mat[i, ]
  fills   <- character(aln_len)
  classes <- character(aln_len)
  
  for (j in seq_len(aln_len)) {
    aa  <- seq_aa[j]
    ref <- ref_row[j]
    
    if (aa == "-") {
      fills[j]   <- blank_gap_color
      classes[j] <- "gap_blank"
      next
    }
    
    if (ref == "-") {
      fills[j]   <- insertion_color
      classes[j] <- "insertion_vs_reference"
      next
    }
    
    if (aa == ref) {
      fills[j]   <- match_color
      classes[j] <- "match"
      next
    }
    
    cls <- grantham_class(grantham_score(aa, ref))
    fills[j]   <- unname(mismatch_colors[cls])
    classes[j] <- cls
  }
  
  rows[[i]] <- data.frame(
    sequence = rownames(aln_mat)[i],
    position = seq_len(aln_len),
    aa       = seq_aa,
    fill     = fills,
    cls      = classes,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
```

```{r}
#| label: Sequence ordering by similarity
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| paged-print: false
data(BLOSUM62)

blosum_dist <- function(m) {
  n <- nrow(m)
  
  d <- matrix(
    0,
    n,
    n,
    dimnames = list(rownames(m), rownames(m))
  )
  
  for (i in seq_len(n - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):n) {
      # Compare only columns where both sequences have amino acids
      cols <- which(m[i, ] != "-" & m[j, ] != "-")
      
      if (!length(cols)) {
        d[i, j] <- d[j, i] <- 1
        next
      }
      
      sc <- mapply(function(a, b) {
        if (a %in% rownames(BLOSUM62) && b %in% colnames(BLOSUM62)) {
          BLOSUM62[a, b]
        } else {
          0L
        }
      }, m[i, cols], m[j, cols])
      
      si <- sapply(m[i, cols], function(a) {
        if (a %in% rownames(BLOSUM62)) BLOSUM62[a, a] else 0L
      })
      
      sj <- sapply(m[j, cols], function(b) {
        if (b %in% rownames(BLOSUM62)) BLOSUM62[b, b] else 0L
      })
      
      ms <- (sum(si) + sum(sj)) / 2
      
      d[i, j] <- d[j, i] <- if (ms > 0) {
        max(0, 1 - sum(sc) / ms)
      } else {
        1
      }
    }
  }
  
  as.dist(d)
}

cat("Clustering sequences ...\n")

dist_mat <- blosum_dist(aln_mat)
hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "average")

seq_order <- rownames(aln_mat)[hc$order]

# Keep reference at bottom
seq_order <- c(setdiff(seq_order, ref_name), ref_name)

df$sequence <- factor(df$sequence, levels = seq_order)
```

```{r}
#| label: Calculate conservation
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| paged-print: false
conservation_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(df, df$position), function(d) {
  non_gap <- d[d$aa != "-", ]
  
  data.frame(
    position = d$position[1],
    conservation = if (nrow(non_gap) == 0) {
      0
    } else {
      max(table(non_gap$aa)) / nrow(d)
    }
  )
}))
```

# TNL expression in roots and shoots {#sec-root-shoot}

Section imported from the standalone report `MMF1_absolute_root_shoot.qmd`:
absolute expression of the RPP1-locus cluster and well-known TNL references in
root and shoot, built from the raw STAR counts of the in-house RNA-seq
(`Input/ReadsPerGene_root_shoot.txt`) so that all libraries are normalised
together and the organ contrast is tested within plant.

```{r}
#| label: rootshoot-setup
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# --- PUBLICATION FIGURE REFERENCE ------------------------------------------
# Supports: Suppl. Fig. S3
#   TNL expression in roots and shoots (Stengele et al. 2026)
#   -> Output/Figures/MMF1_absolute_root_shoot.pdf
# ------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr)
  library(ggplot2); library(knitr); library(ggtext)
})

## dplyr/tidyr verbs are masked in this document: clusterProfiler, AnnotationDbi
## and the Bioconductor stack are attached by earlier chunks, after dplyr, so a
## bare select() dispatches to the S4 generic. Bind the tidyverse versions for
## this section.
select <- dplyr::select; filter <- dplyr::filter; rename <- dplyr::rename
count  <- dplyr::count;  slice_min <- dplyr::slice_min; desc <- dplyr::desc
first  <- dplyr::first;  last <- dplyr::last; collapse <- dplyr::collapse

## ---- the only input: raw STAR read counts, 20 libraries ---------------------
COUNTS <- "Input/ReadsPerGene_root_shoot.txt"
stopifnot(file.exists(COUNTS))
cts <- as.matrix(read.table(COUNTS, header = TRUE, row.names = 1,
                            sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE))

## Sample names encode organ, soil and plant: R_BXm17 = root, BX- soil, plant 17.
cd <- data.frame(sample = colnames(cts)) |>
  mutate(organ = factor(ifelse(startsWith(sample, "R_"), "root", "shoot"),
                        c("shoot", "root")),          # so the coef is root vs shoot
         soil  = factor(ifelse(grepl("BXm", sample), "BX-", "BX+")),
         plant = factor(sub("^._BX[mp]", "", sample)))
rownames(cd) <- cd$sample

## Root and shoot libraries carry the same plant identifiers, so the two organs
## are paired within plant; each plant sits in exactly one soil, so `plant`
## already absorbs the soil factor. Both are asserted rather than assumed.
stopifnot(all(table(cd$plant, cd$organ) == 1),
          all(rowSums(table(cd$plant, cd$soil) > 0) == 1))

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(cts, cd, design = ~ plant + organ)
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) > 0, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)
res <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = "organ_root_vs_shoot", type = "apeglm", quiet = TRUE)

nc  <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)          # one size factor per library
is_r <- cd$organ == "root"
gm   <- tibble(agi = rownames(nc),
               root = rowMeans(nc[, is_r]), shoot = rowMeans(nc[, !is_r]))
MED  <- median(c(gm$root, gm$shoot))           # typical gene, for scale context
SF   <- range(sizeFactors(dds))

fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "NA",
                     ifelse(p < 1e-3, sprintf("%.1e", p), sprintf("%.3f", p)))

ord <- function(n) {                     # 94 -> "94th", 92 -> "92nd"
  n <- round(n)
  sfx <- if (n %% 100 %in% 11:13) "th"
         else switch(as.character(n %% 10), "1" = "st", "2" = "nd", "3" = "rd", "th")
  paste0(n, sfx)
}

## ---- the focus set, as in the reviewer response ----------------------------
focus <- tribble(
  ~agi,        ~sym,    ~grp,
  "AT3G44630", "MMF1",  "RPP1-locus TNLs",
  "AT3G44670", NA,      "RPP1-locus TNLs",
  "AT3G44480", "RPP1",  "RPP1-locus TNLs",
  "AT3G44400", NA,      "RPP1-locus TNLs",
  "AT1G56510", "WRR4",  "Well-known TNLs",
  "AT4G16860", "RPP4",  "Well-known TNLs",
  "AT4G16890", "SNC1",  "Well-known TNLs",
  "AT5G46470", "RPS6",  "Well-known TNLs",
  "AT4G19510", "RPP2B", "Well-known TNLs",
  "AT4G19500", "RPP2A", "Well-known TNLs",
  "AT5G45250", "RPS4",  "Well-known TNLs",
  "AT5G45260", "RRS1",  "Well-known TNLs") |>
  mutate(glab = ifelse(is.na(sym), agi, paste0(sym, " (", agi, ")")),
         grp  = factor(grp, c("RPP1-locus TNLs", "Well-known TNLs")))

rs <- as.data.frame(res[focus$agi, c("log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "padj")]) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("agi") |>
  rename(lfc_model = log2FoldChange, se_model = lfcSE)

fo <- focus |>
  left_join(gm, by = "agi") |> left_join(rs, by = "agi") |>
  mutate(lfc_obs = log2(root / shoot),                  # ratio of drawn means
         fold    = 2^abs(lfc_obs),
         higher  = ifelse(lfc_obs < 0, "shoot", "root"),
         sig     = !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05,
         note    = sprintf("%.1f\u00d7 %s%s", fold, higher, ifelse(sig, "", " (ns)")),
         note_txt = sprintf("%.1f-fold, %s%s", fold, higher, ifelse(sig, "", " (ns)")))
stopifnot(nrow(fo) == 12, !any(is.na(fo$root)))

## ---- per-sample values, exported so the points can be checked --------------
long <- as.data.frame(nc[focus$agi, ]) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("agi") |>
  pivot_longer(-agi, names_to = "sample", values_to = "norm_count") |>
  left_join(cd, by = "sample") |> left_join(focus |> select(agi, glab, grp), by = "agi")

mmf1   <- fo |> filter(agi == "AT3G44630")
rank_r <- mean(gm$root  <= mmf1$root)  * 100
rank_s <- mean(gm$shoot <= mmf1$shoot) * 100
n_gw   <- nrow(gm)
n_ns   <- sum(!fo$sig)
```

*MMF1* is expressed at `r sprintf("%.0f", mmf1$shoot)` normalised counts in
shoot against `r sprintf("%.0f", mmf1$root)` in root, a
`r sprintf("%.1f", mmf1$fold)`-fold shoot bias
(`r sprintf("%+.2f", mmf1$lfc_model)` log~2~ from the paired model, FDR
`r fmt_p(mmf1$padj)`).

```{r}
#| label: fig-abs
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 6.7
#| fig-height: 3.9
#| fig-cap: |
#|   Supplementary Figure S3 | MMF1 and RPP1-locus TNLs are higher expressed in shoots than roots.
#|   Expression levels of MMF1, the other DANGEROUS MIX (DM) 2-locus TNLs, and other
#|   well-characterised TNLs in root and shoot (Transcriptome data from Stengele et al., 2026). Small
#|   points show individual replicates (10 root, 10 shoot; 10 plants); large points show organ means,
#|   connected by grey lines. Counts are DESeq2-normalised, derived from a single model across all 20
#|   samples (design ~ plant + organ), so root and shoot values share one scale. The dashed line
#|   marks the median normalised count across all expressed genes. Numbers at the right give the fold
#|   difference between organ means; ns indicates a paired, within-plant contrast (apeglm-shrunken
#|   log2 fold change) that did not reach FDR < 0.05. Genes are ordered by fold difference within
#|   each group; the x axis is logarithmic.
# --- PUBLICATION FIGURE REFERENCE ------------------------------------------
# Produces: Suppl. Fig. S3
#   TNL expression in roots and shoots (Stengele et al. 2026)
#   -> Output/Figures/MMF1_absolute_root_shoot.pdf
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ROOT <- "#8C510A"; SHOOT <- "#01665E"; COL_MMF1 <- "#B2182B"
base_sz <- 8
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_sz) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_sz + 1),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = base_sz - 1),
          plot.title.position = "plot",
          strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 90, colour = "grey25"),
          legend.key.size = grid::unit(8, "pt")))

lev <- fo |> arrange(grp, lfc_obs) |> pull(glab)
d   <- fo   |> mutate(glab = factor(glab, lev))
lp  <- long |> mutate(glab = factor(glab, lev))
mp  <- d |> select(glab, grp, root, shoot) |>
  pivot_longer(c(root, shoot), names_to = "organ", values_to = "expr") |>
  mutate(organ = factor(organ, c("shoot", "root")))
xmax <- max(lp$norm_count)

## the per-sample points are jittered; fix the seed so the panel is reproducible
set.seed(1)

ggplot(d, aes(y = glab)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = MED, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = root, xend = shoot, yend = glab),
               colour = "grey72", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = lp, aes(x = norm_count, colour = organ),
             size = 0.55, alpha = 0.55,
             position = position_nudge(y = 0.22)) +
  geom_point(data = mp, aes(x = expr, colour = organ), size = 2.1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = xmax * 3.4, label = note), hjust = 0,
            size = 2.1, colour = "grey35") +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(3, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000, 3000, 10000),
                labels = c("3", "10", "30", "100", "300", "1000", "3000", "10000"),
                expand = expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0.34))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(shoot = SHOOT, root = ROOT), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x)
    ifelse(x == mmf1$glab,
           paste0("<span style='color:", COL_MMF1, "'>**", x, "**</span>"), x)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  facet_grid(grp ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  labs(title = "Expression of well-known TNLs in roots and shoots",
              x = "log2(normalised counts)", y = NULL) +
  ## facet_grid(switch = "y") draws the left axis text, and axis.text.y does
  ## not reach it, so the markdown element must be set on that slot
  theme(axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(colour = "grey15"),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = "left",
        legend.margin = margin(t = -4),
        plot.margin = margin(5.5, 30, 5.5, 5.5))
ggsave("Output/Figures/MMF1_absolute_root_shoot.pdf", width = 20, height = 8, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-abs
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# --- PUBLICATION FIGURE REFERENCE ------------------------------------------
# Supports: Suppl. Fig. S3
#   TNL expression in roots and shoots (Stengele et al. 2026)
#   -> Output/Tables/MMF1_absolute_root_shoot.csv
# ------------------------------------------------------------

tb <- d |> arrange(grp, lfc_obs) |>
  transmute(Gene = as.character(glab),
            Group = ifelse(grp == "RPP1-locus cluster", "cluster", "reference"),
            root  = sprintf("%.0f", root),
            shoot = sprintf("%.0f", shoot),
            fold  = sprintf("%.1f%s", fold, ifelse(sig, "", " (ns)")),
            `log2 (model)` = sprintf("%+.2f", lfc_model),
            SE = sprintf("%.2f", se_model),
            FDR = fmt_p(padj))
kable(tb, align = "llrrrrrr",
      caption = "Organ means of normalised counts, the ratio between them, and the paired model's estimate of the same contrast with its FDR. Every gene is shoot-biased, so the fold column gives the ratio without repeating the direction; (ns) marks FDR >= 0.05. Group: cluster = RPP1-locus, reference = well-known TNL. Written alongside this document as MMF1_absolute_root_shoot.csv; the individual library values behind each mean are in MMF1_absolute_root_shoot_per_sample.csv.")

write_csv(d |> arrange(grp, lfc_obs) |>
            select(agi, gene = glab, group = grp,
                   root_mean_norm_count = root, shoot_mean_norm_count = shoot,
                   log2_root_shoot_observed = lfc_obs, fold = fold,
                   higher_in = higher,
                   log2_root_shoot_model = lfc_model, lfcSE_model = se_model,
                   padj = padj) |>
            mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character)),
          "Output/Tables/MMF1_absolute_root_shoot.csv")

write_csv(long |> select(agi, gene = glab, group = grp, sample,
                         organ, soil, plant, norm_count) |>
            mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character)) |>
            arrange(gene, organ, sample),
          "Output/Tables/MMF1_absolute_root_shoot_per_sample.csv")
```

# Session information

**Purpose**: Print the session information, including details about the R version, loaded packages, and the system environment. This is useful for reproducibility, as it documents the computational environment in which the analysis was performed.

```{r}
#| label: Session info
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| paged-print: false
# Get session information
SI <- sessionInfo()

# Extract the attached packages and their versions
attached_packages <- SI$otherPkgs

# Print the R version
cat("R version:", SI$R.version$version.string, "\n\n")

# Print the attached packages and their versions
cat("Attached packages:\n")
invisible(lapply(attached_packages, function(pkg) {
  cat(pkg$Package, "-", pkg$Version, "\n")
}))

```
